metadata.travelWindow: Feb 15 – Mar 23, 2027 (Winter / Off-Peak Season pricing applies through Mar 31 at all seasonal Beijing & Shanghai heritage sites)
metadata.pricingBasis: Total admission for 2 adults in CNY (off-season Feb–Mar rates where seasonal tiers apply). Optional paid add-ons (cable cars, night shows, special exhibitions) noted separately.
metadata.passportRule: Foreign travelers MUST carry their original physical passport for virtually all major Beijing & Shanghai museums, imperial sites, and high-speed rail stations.

activities.name: Yu Garden (Yuyuan Garden)
activities.address: North Gate: No. 168 Fuyou Road / South Gate (individual entry): No. 279 Yuyuan Old Street, Huangpu District, Shanghai
activities.transitFromHotelCluster: 12–20 min via Metro Line 10 or Line 14 to Yuyuan Garden Station (from People's Square, Nanjing Rd, Xintiandi, or Lujiazui); 25 min from Jing'an Temple (Line 14 direct)
activities.priceBreakdown: CN¥30/adult x 2 = CN¥60 (Official off-season rate Dec 1–Mar 31; peak season Apr–Jun & Sep–Nov is CN¥40/adult). Optional winter/spring Fri–Sun evening light tour ('Yu Xiang Shan Lin') is CN¥150–218/adult.
activities.closureExceptions: Closed Mondays (except national statutory holidays). Special Spring Festival / Yuyuan Lantern Festival timed entry applies around Feb 15–20 in the adjacent Yuyuan Malls.
activities.bookingRequirement: On-site ticket windows at North/South Gates or online via 'Shanghai Yuyuan' (上海豫园) WeChat Mini Program.
activities.winterSuitability: Excellent crisp-day stroll; indoor pavilions, teahouses (Huxin Pavilion), and nearby heated dining malls.

activities.name: Shanghai Museum (People's Square & East Pavilion)
activities.chineseName: 上海博物馆（人民广场馆 & 东馆）
activities.address: People's Square: No. 201 Renmin Avenue, Huangpu | East Pavilion: No. 1952 Century Avenue, Pudong
activities.transitFromHotelCluster: People's Square branch: 6–8 min walk from Radisson Blu / 12–20 min via Lines 1/2/8 from all central hotels. East Pavilion: 15–25 min via Line 2 to Shanghai Science & Technology Museum Station.
activities.priceBreakdown: Free permanent collection admission for 2 adults (CN¥0). Selected special temporary exhibitions or VR experiences carry separate fees (e.g., CN¥198 VR add-on).
activities.daysOpen: People's Square: Tue–Sun | East Pavilion: Wed–Mon (staggered closures mean at least one branch is open EVERY day!)
activities.hours: People's Square: 09:00–17:00 (last entry 15:00/16:00) | East Pavilion: 10:00–18:00 (last entry 17:00)
activities.closureExceptions: People's Square closed Mondays; East Pavilion closed Tuesdays (except national holidays).
activities.bookingRequirement: East Pavilion: no individual reservation required (passport for entry). People's Square: advance reservation via Shanghai Museum WeChat/website required during major special exhibitions.
activities.winterSuitability: Top rainy/cold February indoor anchor; climate-controlled world-class bronzes, jade, Ming/Qing furniture & ceramics.

activities.name: Top of Shanghai Observatory (118F, Shanghai Tower)
activities.chineseName: 上海中心大厦 · 上海之巅观光厅
activities.address: No. 501 Yincheng Middle Road, Lujiazui, Pudong New Area, Shanghai
activities.transitFromHotelCluster: 4 min walk from Grand Hyatt Shanghai; 15–25 min via Metro Line 2 or Line 14 to Lujiazui Station from People's Square, Nanjing Rd, Xintiandi & Jing'an.
activities.priceBreakdown: CN¥180/adult x 2 = CN¥360 for 118F Observatory (546m high). Optional Sky 632 damper light-show combo: CN¥268/adult (CN¥536 for 2).
activities.closureExceptions: Open daily year-round; visibility can be reduced on foggy/rainy late-Feb days—check clear-sky forecast before heading up.
activities.bookingRequirement: Buy on-site or online (Trip.com / WeChat) with passport.
activities.winterSuitability: Fully enclosed heated indoor observation deck; ideal for sunset/night skyline views in chilly February.

activities.name: The Bund Promenade & Huangpu River Sightseeing Cruise
activities.address: Shiliupu Pier: No. 551 Zhongshan East 2nd Road, Huangpu District, Shanghai (The Bund spans Zhongshan East 1st Road)
activities.transitFromHotelCluster: 10–15 min walk from Holiday Inn Nanjing Rd; 15–22 min via Line 2/10/14 from Radisson Blu, Langham Xintiandi, PuLi & Grand Hyatt.
activities.priceBreakdown: The Bund promenade is FREE (CN¥0). Official Huangpu River Sightseeing Cruises: Express route CN¥100/adult (CN¥200 for 2); Classic Essence route CN¥120–130/adult (CN¥240–260 for 2); Weekend Longhua–West Bund refined loop CN¥150/adult (CN¥300 for 2).
activities.hours: The Bund: 24/7 (skyline illuminations typically dusk to ~22:00–23:00 in winter). River Cruises: daytime & evening departures roughly 11:00–21:30 (exact night-boat sailing slots confirmed day-of via official 'Huangpu River Cruise' WeChat mini-program).
activities.closureExceptions: Cruises may pause during severe fog or gale advisories on the Huangpu River.
activities.bookingRequirement: Shiliupu Pier physical ticket office (passport required) or 'Huangpu River Cruise' (浦江游览) WeChat Mini Program / Trip.com.
activities.winterSuitability: Bundle up for open top-deck photos; heated indoor viewing cabins available on all classic sightseeing boats.
unverifiedFields: Exact Feb–Mar 2027 night-cruise departure timetable (verify day-of on official 浦江游览 WeChat mini-program)

activities.name: Museum of Art Pudong (MAP)
activities.address: No. 2777 Binjiang Avenue, Lujiazui, Pudong New Area, Shanghai
activities.transitFromHotelCluster: 12 min walk from Grand Hyatt Shanghai; 18–26 min via Metro Line 2 or Line 14 to Lujiazui Station (Exit 2/6) + 10 min walk from Puxi hotels.
activities.priceBreakdown: CN¥80/adult x 2 = CN¥160 (official single all-exhibition museum ticket verified May 2026 via english.shanghai.gov.cn; special add-on VR experiences CN¥30 extra).
activities.daysOpen: Monday – Sunday (Open Daily — rare major museum open on Mondays!)
activities.closureExceptions: Open Mondays (a huge itinerary advantage when Yu Garden, Shanghai Museum People's Square, and West Bund Museum are closed!). Typically closes only 2–3 days over Lunar New Year Eve/Day 1.
activities.bookingRequirement: Online ticket reservation via MAP WeChat Mini Program or on-site box office with passport.
activities.winterSuitability: Exceptional indoor winter sunset venue—Jean Nouvel's giant Mirror Hall windows frame The Bund directly across the river.

socialLinks.label: Wandering in Museum of Art Pudong

activities.name: Jing'an Temple
activities.address: No. 1686 Nanjing West Road, Jing'an District, Shanghai
activities.transitFromHotelCluster: 4 min walk from The PuLi Hotel; 12–25 min via direct Metro Line 2 or Line 14 to Jing'an Temple Station from Radisson Blu, Holiday Inn, Langham Xintiandi & Grand Hyatt.
activities.priceBreakdown: CN¥50/adult x 2 = CN¥100 (verified via Official Shanghai Tourism Portal meet-in-shanghai.net).
activities.closureExceptions: Open daily; extra busy on the 1st and 15th days of the lunar month (Feb 20, 2027 is Lunar Jan 15 / Lantern Festival—expect heavy worship crowds and possible free/special prayer hours).
activities.bookingRequirement: On-site ticket window (cash/Alipay/WeChat Pay) at main gate.
activities.winterSuitability: Compact 45–60 min visit with covered wooden courtyards and direct pairing with Jing An Kerry Centre & 1★ Huaiyang Delights next door.

activities.name: Former French Concession & Xintiandi Heritage Walk (Wukang Rd, Anfu Rd & Shikumen Lanes)
activities.chineseName: 武康路 · 安福路 · 新天地历史风貌区
activities.address: Wukang Mansion (1850 Middle Huaihai Rd, Xuhui) -> Wukang Rd -> Anfu Rd -> Xintiandi (Taicang Rd / Madang Rd, Huangpu)
activities.transitFromHotelCluster: Xintiandi starts at The Langham doorstep; Wukang Rd is 15–25 min via Line 10/11 (Jiao Tong University) or Line 1/7 (Changshu Rd) from all 5 Shanghai hotels.
activities.priceBreakdown: Free public streets and architectural landmarks (CN¥0). Budget CN¥80–200 for two at specialty cafes/bakeries along Anfu Road.
activities.hours: Streets open 24/7; boutiques and cafes typically 10:00–21:00
activities.closureExceptions: None for street strolling; some small historic house museums along Wukang Rd close Mondays.
activities.winterSuitability: Classic winter city walk—plane-tree avenues, Art Deco apartments, warm specialty coffee stops, and direct proximity to 2★ Ji Pin Court & Trine.

socialLinks.label: Shanghai Winter Trip: Anfu & Wukang Roads & Xintiandi (2026)

activities.name: West Bund Museum (Centre Pompidou × West Bund Collaboration)
activities.address: No. 2600 Longteng Avenue, Xuhui District, Shanghai
activities.transitFromHotelCluster: 25–35 min via Metro Line 11 (Yunjin Road Station, 10 min walk) or 15–22 min via DiDi from Xintiandi, People's Square & Jing'an.
activities.priceBreakdown: Exhibition tickets vary by show: CN¥60–120/adult (≈ CN¥120–240 for 2; representative mid-range Centre Pompidou exhibition CN¥100/adult = CN¥200 for 2; public atrium/bookstore 1F/B1 is free).
activities.hours: Exhibition halls: Tue–Sun 10:00–17:00 or 11:00–18:00 depending on active exhibition (last entry 30–60 min prior). 1F/B1 public atrium & cafes open daily 10:00–22:00.
activities.closureExceptions: 2F exhibition galleries CLOSED Mondays (except national holidays). Note: 'Computer Worlds' runs through Feb 14, 2027—check active late-Feb/Mar 2027 Centre Pompidou exhibition schedule on West Bund Life WeChat mini-program.
activities.bookingRequirement: Purchase via 'West Bund Life' WeChat Mini Program or on-site ticket desk.
activities.winterSuitability: Sir David Chipperfield daylight-filled indoor galleries paired with crisp riverside walking along Art Museum Avenue.
unverifiedFields: Exact late-Feb/Mar 2027 exhibition ticket price (depends on post-Feb 14, 2027 rotating Centre Pompidou show; typical verified range CN¥60–120/adult)

activities.name: The Palace Museum (Forbidden City)
activities.address: No. 4 Jingshan Front Street, Dongcheng District, Beijing (Enter via South Meridian Gate / Wu Men)
activities.transitFromHotelCluster: 15–22 min walk or 1 stop Metro from The PuXuan, Hilton Wangfujing & Park Plaza Wangfujing; 20–28 min via Line 1 (Tian'anmen East) from JEN Beijing & InterContinental Sanlitun.
activities.priceBreakdown: CN¥40/adult x 2 = CN¥80 (Official off-season rate Nov 1–Mar 31; peak season Apr 1–Oct 31 is CN¥60/adult). Optional Treasure Gallery (+CN¥10/person) & Clock Gallery (+CN¥10/person) = +CN¥40 for 2.
activities.closureExceptions: CLOSED MONDAYS (except statutory national holidays). NO same-day tickets sold on site! Heightened security checks apply around Tian'anmen during Beijing Two Sessions (early March).
activities.bookingRequirement: MANDATORY advance real-name passport booking (up to 7 days prior at 20:00 Beijing time) via official Palace Museum WeChat Mini Program or international booking portal.
activities.winterSuitability: Clear blue winter skies over snow-dusted golden roofs with far fewer crowds than summer; dress in thermal layers and windproof coat (mostly open-air courtyards).

socialLinks.label: The Palace Museum Beijing — Foreigner Ticket & Visit Guide (2025)

activities.name: Temple of Heaven Park
activities.address: No. 1 Tiantan E. Road, Dongcheng District, Beijing
activities.transitFromHotelCluster: 15–22 min via direct Metro Line 5 (Tiantan Dongmen Station) from Park Plaza & Hilton Wangfujing; 25–35 min via Line 8/10+5 from PuXuan, JEN Beijing & InterContinental Sanlitun.
activities.priceBreakdown: Off-season (Nov 1–Mar 31): Combined Through-Ticket (Park + Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests, Echo Wall, Circular Mound Altar) CN¥28/adult x 2 = CN¥56 (Park-only entry CN¥10/adult = CN¥20 for 2; Peak Apr–Oct Through-Ticket CN¥34/adult).
activities.daysOpen: Park: Daily | Inner Monuments (Hall of Prayer, Echo Wall, Circular Mound): Tuesday – Sunday
activities.hours: Off-Season (Nov 1–Mar 31): Park 06:30–22:00 (last entry 21:00) | Inner Monuments: 08:00–17:00 (last entry 16:30)
activities.closureExceptions: Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests, Echo Wall, Circular Mound Altar & Fasting Palace are CLOSED MONDAYS (except statutory holidays); outer park grounds remain open daily.
activities.bookingRequirement: Online via 'Temple of Heaven Official Ticketing Platform' WeChat account (with passport) or on-site ticket window.
activities.winterSuitability: Bright morning sunshine illuminates the cobalt-blue triple-eaved Hall of Prayer; combine with local tai chi/morning park culture.

socialLinks.label: Temple of Heaven & Summer Palace Guide

activities.name: The Summer Palace (Yiheyuan)
activities.address: No. 19 Xinjian Gongmen Road, Haidian District, Beijing
activities.transitFromHotelCluster: 45–55 min via Metro Line 4 to Beigongmen Station (North Palace Gate) or Xiyuan Station from Wangfujing hotels (Line 1/8/5 -> Line 4); 50–58 min via Line 10 -> Line 4 from Guomao/Sanlitun.
activities.priceBreakdown: Off-season (Nov 1–Mar 31): Combined Through-Ticket (Park + Tower of Buddhist Incense, Garden of Virtue & Harmony, Suzhou Street, Wenchang Gallery) CN¥50/adult x 2 = CN¥100 (Park-only entry CN¥20/adult = CN¥40 for 2; Peak Apr–Oct Through-Ticket CN¥60/adult).
activities.daysOpen: Park: Daily | Paid Inner Courtyards: Tuesday – Sunday
activities.hours: Off-Season (Nov 1–Mar 31): Park 06:30–19:00 (last entry 18:00) | Paid Inner Scenic Spots: 08:30–17:00 (last entry 16:30)
activities.closureExceptions: Tower of Buddhist Incense, Garden of Virtue & Harmony, Suzhou Street & Museum halls CLOSED MONDAYS (except statutory holidays). Kunming Lake boat cruises suspend during winter ice season.
activities.bookingRequirement: On-site comprehensive service ticket window (passport) or 1–7 days ahead on official 'Summer Palace' WeChat account.
activities.winterSuitability: Covered 728m painted Long Corridor shields against wind; in February Kunming Lake often shows dramatic winter ice scenes before March thaw.

socialLinks.label: Summer Palace & Temple of Heaven Beijing

activities.name: Yonghe Temple (Lama Temple)
activities.address: No. 12 Yonghegong Street, Dongcheng District, Beijing
activities.transitFromHotelCluster: 15–20 min via direct Metro Line 5 (Yonghegong Station) from Park Plaza & Hilton Wangfujing; 20–28 min from PuXuan, JEN Beijing & InterContinental Sanlitun. Literally 3 min walk from 2★ King's Joy!
activities.priceBreakdown: CN¥25/adult x 2 = CN¥50 (includes complimentary eco-incense sticks at entrance).
activities.daysOpen: Monday – Sunday (Open Daily — great Monday option!)
activities.closureExceptions: Open daily (including Mondays!). Extremely crowded on Lunar 1st and 15th days (Sat Feb 20, 2027 Lantern Festival) and mornings; daily capacity capped at 40,000 (20k AM / 20k PM).
activities.bookingRequirement: Advance real-name booking (up to 10 days ahead, 08:00–18:00) via official WeChat account '雍和宫游客信众服务' (foreign visitors with passport can also inquire at on-site visitor service window if slots remain).
activities.winterSuitability: Atmospheric fragrant sandalwood halls (incl. 18m Maitreya Buddha carved from a single sandalwood trunk) + Wudaoying Hutong coffee shops & 2★ King's Joy right next door.

socialLinks.label: 5 Things About the Lama Temple (Yonghe Temple)

activities.name: Jingshan Park Panorama & Shichahai / Nanluoguxiang Hutongs
activities.chineseName: 景山公园 & 什刹海 / 南锣鼓巷胡同
activities.address: No. 44 Jingshan West Street, Xicheng District, Beijing (directly north of Forbidden City exit)
activities.transitFromHotelCluster: 14 min walk from The PuXuan (1.0 km); 18–25 min from Hilton/Park Plaza Wangfujing; 30–38 min via Line 1/6/8 from Guomao & Sanlitun.
activities.priceBreakdown: CN¥2/adult x 2 = CN¥4 standard entry (CN¥10/adult during special floral exhibition seasons; Shichahai & Nanluoguxiang hutongs are free).
activities.daysOpen: Monday – Sunday (Open Daily — another great Monday option!)
activities.bookingRequirement: On-site ticket booth at Park Gate (passport/Alipay/WeChat) or 'Visiting Beijing Parks' WeChat account up to 7 days prior.
activities.winterSuitability: Best 10-minute hilltop climb in Beijing for golden-hour panoramic views over the Forbidden City roofs, paired with warm Bib Gourmand noodles at No. 69 Fangzhuanchang nearby.
unverifiedFields: No verified standalone Jingshan Park official social media handle returned in search

activities.name: National Museum of China
activities.address: No. 16 East Chang'an Avenue, Dongcheng District, Beijing (East side of Tian'anmen Square)
activities.transitFromHotelCluster: 15–20 min via Line 1 (Tian'anmen East Station) or walk from Wangfujing hotels; 18–30 min via Line 1 direct from JEN Beijing & InterContinental Sanlitun.
activities.priceBreakdown: Free permanent collection admission for 2 adults (CN¥0; select special international exhibitions may charge separate entry).
activities.closureExceptions: CLOSED MONDAYS (except public holidays). IMPORTANT: Temporary closures or heightened Tian'anmen perimeter restrictions routinely occur on key plenary days during Beijing's Two Sessions (approx. Mar 4–11)—strongly prefer Feb 15–Mar 1!
activities.bookingRequirement: MANDATORY advance real-name passport reservation (7 days prior) via official National Museum WeChat/website; also allows entry into Tian'anmen Square security perimeter.
activities.winterSuitability: World's largest single-building museum—fully heated full-day refuge housing China's Ancient China bronze/jade masterworks.
unverifiedFields: No verified standalone National Museum of China English social media video/handle returned in search

activities.name: 798 · 751 Art District (incl. UCCA Center for Contemporary Art)
activities.address: No. 2 & No. 4 Jiuxianqiao Road, Chaoyang District, Beijing
activities.transitFromHotelCluster: 20–25 min via DiDi or 35–42 min via Metro Line 14 (Wangjing South Station + walk) from InterContinental Sanlitun & JEN Beijing; 35–48 min from Wangfujing hotels.
activities.priceBreakdown: District street & courtyard entry is FREE (CN¥0) year-round. Individual major exhibitions inside UCCA or special museums charge separately (typically CN¥60–198/adult depending on active show).
activities.daysOpen: District: Daily 24/7 | Most galleries & UCCA: Tuesday – Sunday
activities.hours: District open all day; galleries/cafes generally 10:00–18:00 or 19:00
activities.closureExceptions: Major ticketed museums (such as UCCA & teamLab Massless) are typically CLOSED MONDAYS; outdoor sculpture plazas, Bauhaus industrial walkways & cafes remain open.
activities.bookingRequirement: No booking needed for the district; book individual exhibitions via 798 Art Zone WeChat Mini Program or on-site.
activities.winterSuitability: Indoor-outdoor gallery hopping in heated converted 1950s electronics factories with specialty coffee, design shops & zero tour-bus congestion.
unverifiedFields: Exact late-Feb/Mar 2027 UCCA temporary exhibition ticket fee (varies by exhibition)

activities.name: Badaling Great Wall (via Beijing–Zhangjiakou High-Speed Rail)
activities.chineseName: 八达岭长城（京张高铁直达）
activities.address: North Entrance of Guangou Ancient Road, Jundu Mountain, Yanqing District, Beijing (Badaling Great Wall HSR Station)
activities.transitFromHotelCluster: TRANSIT NUANCE: High-speed G-train from Beijing North Station (Xizhimen, Lines 2/4/13) or Qinghe Station takes only 20–27 min rail time! Including Metro to Beijing North (~20–25 min from Wangfujing) + 15 min railway security boarding buffer, total door-to-door is ~60–70 min (flagged transparently vs strict <=60 min threshold; fastest Great Wall access from central Beijing).
activities.priceBreakdown: Off-season (Nov 1–Mar 31): Wall Admission CN¥35/adult x 2 = CN¥70 (Peak Apr–Oct CN¥40/adult). High-speed G-train round-trip adds approx. CN¥36–160/person depending on class (2nd class ~CN¥20–35 each way; optional cable car extra).
activities.daysOpen: Monday – Sunday (Open Daily — ideal Monday excursion when city museums close!)
activities.closureExceptions: Open daily year-round (including Mondays!). In winter, icy steps or high winds can occasionally pause cable cars—wear grippy winter boots and windproof layers.
activities.bookingRequirement: Wall tickets available on-site (no mandatory advance slot per Beijing Gov March 2026 notice), BUT High-Speed G-train tickets (Beijing North <-> Badaling Great Wall) SHOULD be booked 7–15 days ahead on Railway 12306 or Trip.com with passport because morning trains sell out!
activities.winterSuitability: Dramatic snow-dusted mountain ridges and crisp visibility; dress for 5–8°C colder & windier conditions than downtown Beijing (sub-zero mornings in Feb).
unverifiedFields: Total door-to-door transit from downtown hotels slightly exceeds 60 min (~60–70 min including Metro + HSR security buffer; train ride itself is 20–27 min) — flagged explicitly for user awareness
Official 2027 Badaling cable car round-trip price not verified directly on badaling.cn (left out of base admission total)
